title: Ukraine's Zelensky slams Russian 'cynicism' ahead of separate truces
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Tuesday accused Russia of "utter cynicism" for launching deadly attacks while also seeking a truce to stage its May 9 Victory Day parade in Moscow. It comes after both Moscow and Kyiv announced uniliteral ceasefires over different dates this week. France 24's Angela Diffley takes a closer look.
